scope: TMR NACA 0012 zero-angle SSTm production-limiter equation-parity diagnostic

candidate.initialization: same-grid restart from the exact-Sutherland Pr=0.72 baseline final fields
candidate.transport: same exact Sutherland viscosity and molecular Prandtl 0.72
candidate.omega_production: unlimited gamma times G divided by nut, matching NASA TMR SSTm reference source
candidate.k_production: min(G, 20 betaStar omega k), matching NASA TMR SSTm reference source

source_evidence.finding: The prior TmrSSTm implementation inherited and called GbyNu for omega production. In v2512 GbyNu applies a limiter, whereas NASA's reference source uses unlimited G/nut in omega and G2 only in k.

report: fraction of the remaining benchmark discrepancy attributable to limiter placement
decision_rule.benchmark_acceptance: A passing diagnostic does not accept the benchmark by itself. If it reaches the existing force-and-moment uncertainty gate, all affected numerical-independence gates must be repeated with the corrected model before acceptance.
decision_rule.failure_handling: Preserve a failed or nonconverged candidate and do not use its coefficients.
